source: Ported from agent-lab .devcontainer/bootstrap-linux.sh (node, uv, gh, codex, claude) plus fresh 2026-09-22 fetches for qmd, mcporter, rtk, ai-memory, context-mode. Each archive was downloaded into a disposable worktree temp directory and hashed with sha256sum; npm entries were additionally cross-checked against `npm view <pkg> dist.integrity` (sha512, base64) computed with `openssl dgst -sha512 -binary | base64` over the same downloaded tarball -- all five matched exactly.

tools.install_note: Verified against https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/SHASUMS256.txt fetched 2026-09-22; also matches the pin already carried in agent-lab .devcontainer/bootstrap-linux.sh. Extract with --strip-components=1 into tools/node-24.21.0; symlink bin/{node,npm,npx,corepack}.
Verified against the release's .sha256 sidecar fetched 2026-09-22; matches the existing agent-lab devcontainer pin. Archive also contains uvx; install both.

v2.101.0 was GitHub's actual 'latest' release for cli/cli on 2026-09-22 (queried via `gh api repos/cli/cli/releases/latest`); hash verified against the release's gh_2.101.0_checksums.txt. Binary is at bin/gh inside the archive.

npm registry tarball for @openai/codex@0.155.1 (thin wrapper package, 4904 bytes); npm dist.integrity sha512-02fAAGyBtlA1zPjEo3kTj/bOSYbPz5DvjLwRZJdV7weFFEDzNFOMjQGmZ/+5CuirYV0hE+AZTrnjzwXYU4AdAQ== matches a fresh openssl sha512/base64 digest of the same download. `npm install --global --prefix tools/codex-0.155.1 @openai/codex@0.155.1`. The complete native package (codex-code-mode-host, bundled rg) used by the agent-lab devcontainer script is a separate, larger GitHub release asset; this pin follows the npm alternative the task specified.

minimum version; native auto-update on the latest channel. Raised from 2.1.280 (1e08503dbdf3c2cb0d706d32f3408277388d1c76ef108673e8fe42c1b322925b, verified 2026-09-23 by downloading the linux-x64 binary and re-hashing it) in step with the macOS pin, since shared components keep one version on both platforms: 2.1.281 fixes a recursive rm of command-substitution output running unprompted in auto and --dangerously-skip-permissions mode. This sha256 is the 2.1.281 manifest.json's platforms.linux-x64.checksum (fetched 2026-09-24, size 237375560); the linux-x64 binary was not re-downloaded or re-hashed for it, and fetch() verifies the served bytes against it before anything runs. Superseded the prior npm-wrapper pin (2.1.278, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1) once the native installer became the reference path: fetch the binary, verify its sha256, then run `"$bin" install 2.1.281`, matching ~/codex-ecosystem/bin/bootstrap-linux.sh's own claude-code step. The installed binary self-manages ~/.local/share/claude/versions and the ~/.local/bin/claude launcher and auto-updates on the latest channel from there; this pin is a floor, not a ceiling, and no DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER opt-out is set. adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh still runs that install unconditionally (only bootstrap-macos.sh keeps an installed launcher at or above the pin), so a re-run there moves a newer install back to this pin.

npm dist.integrity sha512-zjfVwrObPB618B6x8SdhlGv/tX9OxRHsbQnr5DUtBvqPK6HGQ27lM+9/BAY5okpjrHVnW56hLyDkqoTcsrVLzA== matched. `npm install --global --prefix tools/qmd-2.8.3 @tobilu/qmd@2.8.3`, matching recipes/README.md.

Verified against the release's ai-memory-linux-x86_64.tar.gz.sha256 sidecar fetched 2026-09-22, following the upstream source named in blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-native-tools/pins.json's convention and recipes/README.md's ai-memory row (official akitaonrails/ai-memory v2.3.2 archive).

npm dist.integrity sha512-rgltHjpmdsBzErnWfAlNsW6Sn5B3y3Qli8phNtKkgn7s/Lk3Uf1YWLpqJXrIXjhxzBR67Oi5Z3+wxptn/vxFkA== matched. `npm install --global --prefix tools/mcporter-0.13.13 mcporter@0.13.13`, matching recipes/README.md. Requires Node >=24.

npm dist.integrity sha512-94JIaFuLjF9SO2BsGTrbGtyT44K95+9OC8BdbaL/UT76xOkanJLfUR5CzmNw+GELXZQqH4nBrKg9wjBnSFkVnQ== matched. recipes/README.md flags that the npm context-mode@1.0.169 release is a DIFFERENT source revision from the native plugin pin (git 6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b installed via `codex plugin marketplace add` / `claude plugin marketplace add`) and is not a substitute for full plugin evidence. This pin installs the npm CLI package only (`npm install --global --prefix tools/context-mode-1.0.169 context-mode@1.0.169`) so the script can place an executable on PATH; it does NOT install or replace the client-native plugin, and does not by itself establish the plugin-level acceptance recorded elsewhere in the catalog.

2026-09-23 catalog-winner-but-unpinned gap: this host already has markitdown 0.1.7 (Microsoft's Office/PDF/HTML-to-Markdown converter), installed as a uv tool: its uv-receipt.toml requires markitdown==0.1.7 with no-build, and its console script's shebang points into the tool's own virtualenv. The artifact at the URL above was re-downloaded and sha256-hashed independently; it matches PyPI's published digest (https://pypi.org/pypi/markitdown/0.1.7/json urls[].digests.sha256, read 2026-09-23). install_pin's *-uv-tool case runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 markitdown==0.1.7` into UV_TOOL_DIR, so the entry point runs in its own environment. uv resolves the pinned version from PyPI and does not check this sha256; it is recorded as an independent artifact cross-check and satisfies this catalog's fail-closed null-sha256 refusal.

2026-09-23 catalog-winner-but-unpinned gap: `uv tool list` shows tavily-cli 0.1.8 already installed on this host (its `tvly` command). The artifact at the URL above was re-downloaded and sha256-hashed independently; it matches PyPI's published digest (https://pypi.org/pypi/tavily-cli/0.1.8/json, read 2026-09-23). install_pin's *-uv-tool case runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 tavily-cli==0.1.8`, the same mechanism as this host's install. uv resolves the pinned version from PyPI and does not check this sha256; it is recorded as an independent artifact cross-check and satisfies this catalog's fail-closed null-sha256 refusal.

2026-09-23 catalog-winner-but-unpinned gap: this host already has OpenResearch's `orx` CLI 0.2.7 installed (confirmed with `orx --version`; alphaXiv/OpenResearch, the local-first research-agent workspace). Archive re-downloaded and sha256-hashed independently; matches the release's own `openresearch-cli-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz.sha256` sidecar (`gh api repos/alphaXiv/OpenResearch/releases/tags/v0.2.7`, read 2026-09-23) exactly. `tar -tJf` lists exactly one top-level directory containing `orx`, `README.md` and `LICENSE`, matching `install_single_binary_tarball`'s convention of finding a single file literally named `orx` in the extracted tree.

2026-09-23 catalog-winner-but-unpinned gap: this host already has agent-browser 0.38.1 installed (confirmed with `agent-browser --version`). npm registry tarball re-downloaded independently; npm dist.integrity sha512-k58FCz0yUOCANoNkMiqJe+H2y6r6sUZazqXsWF+MYq1iRC42PjtLcBoag6SSTOD/FRQppvPDvE5HDYEhclvnhw== matches a fresh openssl sha512/base64 digest of the same download exactly. `npm install --global --prefix tools/agent-browser-0.38.1 agent-browser@0.38.1`. The host's actual installed copy places its own platform binary at `node_modules/agent-browser/bin/agent-browser-linux-x64`, resolved by the package's own postinstall/bin dispatch; `install_npm`'s existing generic `bin/*` symlink loop covers this the same way it covers every other npm-kind pin here.
